messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up handoff for Helios Metrics (enterprise pilot). Signed today. Pilot: 2xA100 Dedicated, target scale to 6x by month-2 if latency good. Data residency required: EU only. Exec: Lars Meyer (CTO). Go-live pilot target 2024-06-01. Main knowns/risks: SAML SSO cert rotation window, EU peering + egress billing questions, and early prompt hallucinations on domain-specific metrics data. Adding @miguel_cs and @tom_eng as owners. :handshake:

miguel_cs: I can own CS side. Will run kickoff and collect trial feedback. Need legal contact and exact MSA addendum about data residency. Also want initial success metrics from Sales (SLA, latency targets, acceptable error rates).

emma_sales: Legal contact = nina.legal@helios.ai. MSA notes: signed with EU data clause; customer asked for audit logs retention 13 months. Billing contact: finance@helios.ai. I shared pilot prompt set link in the shared folder.

infra_bot: Tickets created: CS-7900 "Helios EU peering - customer network details" and ENG-6701 "Helios SAML cert rotation - investigate auto-renew". https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-7900 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-6701

deepa_csm: I'll handle daily CSM cadence and capture product feedback. Requesting a pre-kickoff sync with Eng to confirm SSO test plan and the fallback policy for model degradation. Can Eng do a 20m slot on 5/22?

tom_eng: I can do 5/22 10:30am PT. For SAML we need metadata XML + test SP entityID + cert expiry date. For EU peering, need allowed CIDR and whether they want private IP routing or NAT. ETA on ENG ticket triage 72h.

ops_se: I'll draft onboarding checklist and costs calc. Initial notes: pilot pool 2xA100 -> scale path to 6x; estimate token cost baseline (see example):

```
# cost estimate sample
avg_tokens_per_request=800
requests_per_minute=40
monthly_est_tokens = avg_tokens_per_request * requests_per_minute * 60 * 24 * 30
```

Will share spreadsheet by EOD tomorrow. Need sample traffic distribution to refine.

miguel_cs: Quality guardrails: capture top-10 prompt examples that failed, establish baseline pass rate >95% for metric extraction. We'll run initial evals during week 1 of pilot. Who owns custom eval harness?

tom_eng: Eng can spin up eval harness; prefer CSM to supply labeled ground truth for 50 examples. We can run nightly regression checks and alert on drift. Also recommend enabling prefix caching for recurring system prompts to reduce cost.

emma_sales: Customer requested an SLA for 99.5% availability during pilot. Confirm if that aligns with Dedicated offering. Also they asked about dedicated audit logs export to their S3 in EU.

miguel_cs: Action list (draft): 1) Emma to share legal + billing contacts and prompt set link (COMPLETE) 2) Infra_bot tickets active CS-7900 / ENG-6701 3) Tom to triage SAML and EU peering (ETA 72h) 4) Ops_se to provide cost spreadsheet by EOD 5) Deepa to schedule kickoff week of 5/20 and collect 50 labeled GT examples for eval. I'll own weekly status updates and renewal risk flag if pilot metrics < targets. Any objections or additional owners? :eyes:
